answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making influence exactly proportional to locked stake, dividing reward pro-rata by total stake, not headcount. One fortune kept whole earns exactly what that fortune split into a thousand wallets earns: the ledger weights by capital, so a thousand voices from one purse sum to one voice. Chopping one cedar's timber into splinters leaves the wood unchanged, stacked or scattered on a mesa. Each clone still owes per-epoch liveness work, so a ripple of new identities adds cost, not influence. It blocks cheap flooding; a richer attacker still dominates.
